title: Phase-1 direct Watch HTTPS protocol, frozen v1
description: Contract only. Every utterance starts with a user tap. Replies are text/haptic only; no automatic listening or audio playback. All JSON objects reject unknown keys. Authorization is an HTTP bearer credential, never a JSON body field.

utterance.body: Unmodified MPEG-4 audio container with AAC-LC, 16000 Hz, one channel; binary, not JSON or base64.

semantics.identity: Existing formal Watch binding is authoritative. Credential binds principal, owning iPhone, watch_device_id, installation_id and pair_version. Caller cannot select principal/session. Revalidate current pair status/version and parent authority on every request; revoke/replace invalidates prior credentials.
semantics.credential_lifetime: Proposed 7-day rolling maximum, capped by canonical Watch binding expiry. Lifetime remains a product/authority decision; no implementation or runtime guarantee.
semantics.credential_refresh: Only the owning paired iPhone can issue, refresh or revoke; all three actions validate current paired primary authority, canonical binding ownership, installation and expected_pair_version under the same authority transaction/fence. Refresh rotates the token. The ledger stores only the non-secret outcome, never the token. Replaying a committed issue/refresh with the same request_id and request hash revalidates the active binding, pair_version and current parent authority, then rotates again in the same transaction and returns a new token with the original non-secret fields, including expires_at. Only the latest committed token is valid. Revoke and failed-outcome replay return the stored outcome. Conflicting request_id returns request_conflict. The iPhone sends one credential request at a time and retains only its latest attempt's response. Binding revoke/replace invalidates all prior credentials. Credential-only revoke does not mutate the canonical identity binding.
semantics.idempotency: Durable key is (principal, registered watch_device_id, pair_version, turn_id). Exact audio bytes and normalized metadata replay one outcome across concurrent requests and restart. Changed bytes or metadata return HTTP 409 turn_conflict. No duplicate ASR confirmation, processed event or Agent admission.
semantics.admission: heard means raw original is durably archived and exactly selected transcript has passed the shared formal voice_send confirmation and admission path. Do not return heard for a spool-only ACK or an unconfirmed candidate.
semantics.reply: GET resolves only the authenticated Watch key and its persisted processed event/session. Reply reuses canonical result output and owning iPhone conversation. It does not create another run. Do not return another Watch or user reply. Return replied only for canonical completed/sealed output with admission visible, never for a partial streaming chunk. Subscribe before re-reading the scoped result to close the completion race; release subscriptions on result, timeout or disconnect. Publication and phone mirroring keep existing authoritative output identities.
semantics.wait: Wait at most 25 seconds, then HTTP 200 working. Client cancellation ends only its wait. Processing continues. Unknown keys including query keys are rejected.
semantics.http_status: heard/working/replied:200; malformed input:400; absent/invalid/expired credential:401; revoked/unregistered/scope denial:403; missing turn:404; turn conflict:409; size or duration:413; codec:415; invalid audio/not heard:422; busy:429; unavailable:503; processing failed:502. All failures use failed+reason; turn_id is omitted only if unavailable or unsafe to echo.
semantics.binary_validation: HTTP boundary enforces content length and actual streamed byte count <=1,000,000, nonempty audio, AAC-LC/16kHz/mono decoded properties, actual duration <=30s and consistency with duration header. JSON Schema cannot validate binary content or credential ownership.
semantics.verification: Gateway image installs ffmpeg; source has MP4 demux to PCM but no direct Watch endpoint. Deployment acceptance must prove an AAC-LC audio/mp4 fixture decodes in the staged gateway image and traverses archive, ASR, confirmation, admission and scoped reply. Contract tests prove JSON shape only.
semantics.archive: Every authenticated, bounded accepted upload enters existing RawArchive/OriginalAdmission before decoding or ASR. Keep original AAC container bytes and source/turn metadata in L5, including not_heard and later processing failures. PCM is a derived ASR input, never a replacement for the original. Over-limit bodies are rejected at ingress.
